rationale: Both parties agree readiness validates only the format of compose_hash, not its equality to the submitted compose; the disputed premise is whether a successful pinned-CLI update can expose the previous running compose under the returned VM identity. scripts/phala-setup.mjs:186–197 and 222–226 bind polling to the deploy-returned vm_uuid, while tests/phala-setup.test.mjs:301–360 exercise only inventory/get and 435–473 mock an unchanging identity; with the installed CLI unavailable, the required stale-state behavior is unproven, so the finding is dismissed.
title: Wait for the requested compose identity before accepting an update
